pages.title: Master of Magic
pages.text: $(deity)Thoth$() commands powerful magical abilities. He can cast magic projectiles, unleash scroll blasts of forbidden knowledge, and even bend time itself.$(br2)Approach with caution and respect.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Magic Ball$(): Ranged attack$(li)$(l)Staff Strike$(): Melee attack$(li)$(l)Scroll Blast$(): Area attack$(li)$(l)Time Bend$(): Temporal magic$(li)$(l)Summon$(): Calls servants$(br2)$(warning)Do not engage unprepared!
